description: Trim exactly one source in/out point and verify the corresponding visible timeline edge. Requires accessible physical media duration from ffprobe; unknown duration or linked partners using different source files refuse before mutation. Refuses retimed clips, extensions that would overlap the neighbouring clip on the same track, and, by default, trims that would leave effect keyframes outside the visible clip. Linked audio/video partners get the same trim by default (include_linked), applied as the same offset from each partner's own source point so a J/L cut or slipped audio stays in sync; every clip is checked before any is changed. To set a clip's timeline length or extend a still image, use set_clip_duration.

expected_cep_target.description: Optional reviewed CEP sequence/clip identity and exact tick ranges. Checked before every generated command; UXP refuses this CEP-only guard.

effect.description: Reviewed effect and parameter identity checked before mutation.

match_name.description: Effect match name from host inspection.

end_ticks.description: Exact expected exclusive timeline end ticks.

out_ticks.description: Exact expected exclusive source Out ticks.

track_index.description: Expected zero-based track index; identity still checked.

project_document_id.description: Exact Premiere project document ID observed during review.

source_item.description: Reviewed source identity for a source-only operation.

expected_project_path.description: Optional absolute saved-project path. Every generated CEP command refuses before its body when the active project differs or is unsaved. UXP commands refuse this CEP-only guard; local-only tools do not inspect Premiere. Omit to keep existing behavior.

include_linked.description: Also apply the edit to the clip's linked audio/video partners, as Premiere does with linked selection (default: true).

keyframe_policy.description: How to handle effect keyframes beyond the trimmed visible range: reject (default) leaves the timeline unchanged; preserve explicitly keeps them and reports their count.

new_in_seconds.description: New source in-point in seconds (relative to the clip's source media). Specify exactly one edit point.

new_out_seconds.description: New source out-point in seconds (relative to the clip's source media). Specify exactly one edit point.

node_id.description: Node ID of the clip to trim

name: trim_clip

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true; on failure, diagnostic detail when the tool provides it.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

receipt.description: Versioned common mutation receipt; success never implies rendered verification.
